findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#y7-ar0" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 1.02s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and "z" renders at 22 px for 3.12 s: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
